sequences.name: Start Mastercam using your preferred method
sequences.description: Double-click Mastercam's desktop icon or launch it from the Windows Start menu.

steps.text: Double-click Mastercam's desktop icon or launch it from the Windows Start menu

sequences.name: Select the default metric configuration file
sequences.description: Click the File tab, choose Configuration from Mastercam's Backstage View to open the SystemConfiguration dialog box, select ...\mcamxm.config<Metric> from the Current drop-down list, and click OK.

steps.text: Click the File tab, choose Configuration from Mastercam's Backstage View to open the SystemConfiguration dialog box, select ...\mcamxm.config<Metric> from the Current drop-down list, and click OK

sequences.name: Open the file MarkerTray
sequences.description: Select the Solidstab and then Extrude.

steps.text: Select the Solidstab

sequences.name: Chain the outer rectangle
sequences.description: Click OK in the Chaining dialog box.

steps.text: Click OK in the Chaining dialog box

sequences.name: Reverse the extruded direction
sequences.description: Click ReverseAll in the function panel.

steps.text: Click ReverseAll in the function panel

sequences.name: Set the extrude distance to 2
sequences.description: Set the extrudeDistance to 2 and press [Tab] or [Enter].

steps.text: Set the extrudeDistance to 2 and press [Tab] or [Enter]

sequences.name: Create a new operation to finalize the extrude operation
sequences.description: Click OK and CreateNewOperation.

steps.text: Click OK and CreateNewOperation

sequences.name: Chain the insiderectangle
sequences.description: Click OK in the Chaining dialog box.

steps.text: Click OK in the Chaining dialog box

sequences.name: Set the type to Add boss
sequences.description: Select the Advanced tab and set the Type to Addboss.

steps.text: Select the Advanced tab and set the Type to Addboss

sequences.name: Select Draft and leave angle at 5
sequences.description: Select Draft and leave Angle at 5.

steps.text: Select Draft and leave Angle at 5

sequences.name: Create the operation
sequences.description: Click OK to create the operation.

steps.text: Click OK to create the operation

sequences.name: Save the file as MarkerTray01-XXX
sequences.description: Save the file as MarkerTray01-XXX, where XXX is your initials.

steps.text: Save the file as MarkerTray01-XXX, where XXX is your initials

sequences.name: Turn on the UpperBlockWireframe level
sequences.description: Click the Levels tab in the lower-left of Mastercam’s window and turn on the UpperBlockWireframe level by clicking in its Visible column.

steps.text: Click the Levels tab in the lower-left of Mastercam’s window and turn on the UpperBlockWireframe level by clicking in its Visible column

sequences.name: Select the Solidstab and then Extrude for upper bosses
sequences.description: Select the Solidstab and then Extrude.

steps.text: Select the Solidstab

sequences.name: Use Chaining dialog box to combine shapes
sequences.description: Select two new rectangles, chain them in the Chaining dialog box, and click OK.

steps.text: Select two new rectangles, chain them in the Chaining dialog box, and click OK

sequences.name: Set extrusion distance using ruler
sequences.description: Click the blue arrow, hover over the mouse, and use the ruler to set the extrusion distance.

steps.text: Click the blue arrow, hover over the mouse, and use the ruler to set the extrusion distance

sequences.name: Snap to ruler increments
sequences.description: Move the mouse over the ruler until it snaps to a 25mm increment, then click to set the new distance.

steps.text: Move the mouse over the ruler until it snaps to a 25mm increment,
click to set the new distance

sequences.name: Select Wireframe Quick Mask for selection
sequences.description: Select the left-hand portion of the Wireframe Quick Mask button to select wireframe geometry.

steps.text: Select the left-hand portion of the Wireframe Quick Mask button to select wireframe geometry

sequences.name: Use Divide function to trim geometry
sequences.description: Select the Divide function from the Wireframe tab, ensure 'Trim' is selected, and click the line to trim the geometry.

steps.text: Select the Divide function from the Wireframe tab, ensure 'Trim' is selected, and click the line to trim the geometry

sequences.name: Save file after completing operations
sequences.description: Save the file as MarkerTray05-XXX.

steps.text: Save the file as MarkerTray05-XXX

sequences.name: Select draft face for draft creation
sequences.description: Select the top face of the same wall as the reference face.

steps.text: Select the top face of the same wall as the reference face

sequences.name: Set draft angle to 10 degrees
sequences.description: Set the Angle to 10.

steps.text: Set the Angle to 10

sequences.name: Select constant fillet for edge selection
sequences.description: Select Constant Fillet on the Solid tab.

steps.text: Select Constant Fillet on the Solid tab

sequences.name: Set fillet radius to 5 units
sequences.description: Set Radii to 5.

steps.text: Set Radii to 5

sequences.name: Select top faces for fillets
sequences.description: Select the ten faces shown below and click OK in the Solid Selection dialog box.

steps.text: Select the ten faces shown below and click OK in the Solid Selection dialog box

sequences.name: Adjust fillet radius to avoid warning
sequences.description: Set the Radius to 1 after receiving a warning about the radius being too large.

steps.text: Set the Radius to 1 after receiving a warning about the radius being too large

sequences.name: Save file after draft and fillets operations
sequences.description: Save the file as MarkerTray06-XXX.

steps.text: Save the file as MarkerTray06-XXX

sequences.name: Select shell function for shelling operation
sequences.description: Select Shell on the Solid tab.

steps.text: Select Shell on the Solid tab

sequences.name: Set shell thickness for direction 1 to 3
sequences.description: Set the Shell Thickness for Direction 1 to 3.

steps.text: Set the Shell Thickness for Direction 1 to 3

sequences.name: Save file after shelling operation
sequences.description: Save the file as MarkerTray07-XXX.

steps.text: Save the file as MarkerTray07-XXX

sequences.name: Select Revolve function for revolving operation
sequences.description: Select Revolve on the Solid tab.

steps.text: Select Revolve on the Solid tab

sequences.name: Select line as axis of rotation
sequences.description: Select the line indicated below. This line is your axis of rotation.

steps.text: Select the line indicated below

sequences.name: Save file after revolving operation
sequences.description: Save the file as SpindlePartial01-XXX.

steps.text: Save the file as SpindlePartial01-XXX

sequences.name: Select Sweep function for sweeping operation
sequences.description: Select Sweep from the Solid tab.

steps.text: Select Sweep from the Solid tab

sequences.name: Save file after sweeping operation
sequences.description: Save the file as SpindlePartial02-XXX.

steps.text: Save the file as SpindlePartial02-XXX

sequences.name: Select Boolean function for creating a hole
sequences.description: Select Boolean from the Solid tab.

steps.text: Select Boolean from the Solid tab

sequences.name: Select swept solid for Boolean operation
sequences.description: Click Add Selection under Tool Bodies to select the tool body.

steps.text: Click Add Selection under Tool Bodies to select the tool body

sequences.name: Select main body of the part for Boolean operation
sequences.description: Click Select Target Body to select the main body of the part.

steps.text: Click Select Target Body to select the main body of the part

sequences.name: Select One Distance Chamfer from Solid tab
sequences.description: Open Solid Selection dialog box, turn off all filters except Edge, select edge, click OK.

steps.text: Open Solid Selection dialog box, turn off all filters except Edge, select edge, click OK

sequences.name: Select Impression from Solid tab
sequences.description: Open Chaining dialog box, chain wireframe rectangle above solid, turn off all filters except Body, select solid body.

steps.text: Open Chaining dialog box, chain wireframe rectangle above solid, turn off all filters except Body, select solid body

sequences.name: Change hole diameter
sequences.description: Set Diameter to 10mm.

steps.text: Set Diameter to 10mm

sequences.name: Remove a position from the list
sequences.description: Right-click on Position-1 and select Remove.

steps.text: Right-click on Position-1 and select Remove

sequences.name: Set hole depth to through all
sequences.description: Set Depth to Throughall.

steps.text: Set Depth to Throughall

sequences.name: Set hole type to countersink
sequences.description: Set Type to Countersink and Diameter to 6mm.

steps.text: Set Type to Countersink and Diameter to 6mm

sequences.name: Select a plane for the hole
sequences.description: Select Front plane in the PlanesManager.

steps.text: Select Front plane in the PlanesManager

sequences.name: Select points on the front face of the solid
sequences.description: Click the left side of the ArcQuickMask to select all arc entities.

steps.text: Click the left side of the ArcQuickMask to select all arc entities

sequences.name: Set plane orientation to CPlane
sequences.description: Select AddPosition and click OK.

steps.text: Select AddPosition and click OK

sequences.name: Select a vector for the hole direction
sequences.description: Click SelectVector under PlaneOrientation.

steps.text: Click SelectVector under PlaneOrientation

sequences.name: Select a line as the vector
sequences.description: Right-click in the graphics window and select GView, Trimetric(WCS). Select the line shown below.

steps.text: Right-click in the graphics window and select GView, Trimetric(WCS)
Select the line shown below

sequences.name: Set hole depth to through all with vector
sequences.description: Set Depth to Throughall.

steps.text: Set Depth to Throughall

sequences.name: Set hole type to simple with vector
sequences.description: Set the Type to Simple and enter a Diameter of 10mm.

steps.text: Set the Type to Simple and enter a Diameter of 10mm

sequences.name: Create a hole using a vector line
sequences.description: Click OK to create the operation.

steps.text: Click OK to create the operation

sequences.name: Select a face for the hole
sequences.description: Click SelectFace under PlaneOrientation.

steps.text: Click SelectFace under PlaneOrientation

sequences.name: Select a chamfered face for the hole
sequences.description: Select the chamfered faceshown below.

steps.text: Select the chamfered faceshown below

sequences.name: Set hole type to counterdrill with face
sequences.description: Set the Type to Counterdrill and set Diameter to 5mm.

steps.text: Set the Type to Counterdrill and set Diameter to 5mm

sequences.name: Create a counterdrill hole
sequences.description: Click OK to create the operation.

steps.text: Click OK to create the operation

sequences.name: Create a preset for the hole operation
sequences.description: Double-click on the Counterdrilloperation in the SolidsManager, select AddPreset and enter Counterdrill5 as the Name.

steps.text: Double-click on the Counterdrilloperation in the SolidsManager, select AddPreset and enter Counterdrill5 as the Name

sequences.name: Add a new category for the preset
sequences.description: Select AddPreset, enter Counterdrills as the Category name and click OK.

steps.text: Select AddPreset, enter Counterdrills as the Category name and click OK

sequences.name: Use Mastercam's Solid Hole function to create a tapered hole
sequences.description: Select the Hole function panel, change the Type to Taper, and set the Category to Counterdrills.

steps.text: Select the Hole function panel, change the Type to Taper, and set the Category to Counterdrills

sequences.name: Modify a part using Model Prep functions
sequences.description: Use functions like Push/Pull, Move, and Split Solid Faces to edit solids without history.

steps.text: Use functions like Push/Pull, Move, and Split Solid Faces to edit solids without history

sequences.name: Split feet from the part using Model Prep
sequences.description: Load FlangeDemo, save as FlangeDemo-XXX, and use Split Solid Faces to separate feet.

steps.text: Load FlangeDemo, save as FlangeDemo-XXX, and use Split Solid Faces to separate feet

sequences.name: Remove one foot using Push-Pull
sequences.description: Select Push-Pull, place the part in Isometric view, click the lower-left foot, and drag downward to remove it.

steps.text: Select Push-Pull, place the part in Isometric view, click the lower-left foot, and drag downward to remove it

sequences.name: Reduce foot height using Push-Pull
sequences.description: Select Push-Pull, click the top face of each foot, enter -2.5 to reduce height by 2.5mm.

steps.text: Select Push-Pull, click the top face of each foot, enter -2.5 to reduce height by 2.5mm

sequences.name: Use window selection to select all faces of a feature
sequences.description: Select all faces of the left-hand foot using window selection.

steps.text: Select all faces of the left-hand foot using window selection

sequences.name: Change the center of rotation for Move operation
sequences.description: Click the gnomon's button to change from geometry manipulation mode to gnomon manipulation mode, then click the ball at the gnomon's origin and place it at the center of the part.

steps.text: Click the gnomon's button to change from geometry manipulation mode to gnomon manipulation mode,
click the ball at the gnomon's origin and place it at the center of the part

sequences.name: Rotate selected feature using gnomon
sequences.description: Click the center segment of the blue control on the gnomon to activate 2D rotation around the Z-axis, then type 30 and press [Enter].

steps.text: Click the center segment of the blue control on the gnomon to activate 2D rotation around the Z-axis,
type 30 and press [Enter]

sequences.name: Resize holes using Push-Pull

steps.text: Select the three foot holes, click the red arrow to display the ruler control, type 6.0 and press [Enter] twice

sequences.name: Create a counterbore using Push-Pull and Split Solid Faces
sequences.description: Select the center hole, click the red arrow, type 10 and press [Enter] twice to change the hole's diameter to 20mm. Create a 30mm diameter circle at the center of the part, then select Split Solid Faces.

steps.text: Select the center hole, click the red arrow, type 10 and press [Enter] twice to change the hole's diameter to 20mm
Create a 30mm diameter circle at the center of the part,
select Split Solid Faces
